app.name: Freelief
app.tagline: Breathe with the circle. You are safe right now.
nav.breatheHint: Follow the circle in and out.
nav.groundHint: Notice what is around you, one sense at a time.
nav.bubblesHint: Slow, soft bubbles. Pop as many as you like.
nav.traceHint: Follow a slow loop with your finger or the arrow keys.
nav.settingsHint: Breathing rhythm, soft tones and colours.
breathe.title: Breathe
breathe.paused: Paused. Resume when you are ready.
ground.title: Ground yourself
ground.intro: Take your time. There is no right answer.
ground.5: Look around you. Find five things you can see.
ground.4: Notice four things you can touch or feel. Your feet on the floor. Your hands.
ground.3: Listen. Find three things you can hear.
ground.2: Notice two things you can smell, or two smells you like.
ground.1: Notice one thing you can taste, or take one slow sip of water.
ground.done: Well done. You are here, in this moment.
statements.title: Calming words
statements.list: This feeling is strong, and it will pass.
You have felt this before, and it passed.
Your body is trying to protect you. You are safe right now.
You do not have to fight it. Let it rise, and let it fall.
Breathe out slowly. Your heart can slow down too.
These feelings are uncomfortable, but they will fade.
Feel your feet on the ground. You are here.
It is okay to feel this way.
You are doing well. Stay with it.
bubbles.title: Pop bubbles
bubbles.intro: Tap a bubble, or move to one and press Enter. There is nothing to win.
trace.title: Trace a shape
trace.intro: Move the dot slowly around the loop with your finger, or with the arrow keys. Go at your own pace.
trace.oneLoop: One loop. Keep going for as long as you like.
trace.loops: {count} loops. Keep going for as long as you like.
settings.title: Settings
settings.tonesHint: Gentle sounds that mark breathing in and out. Off unless you turn them on.
help.title: Urgent help
help.intro: If you might act on thoughts of harming yourself, or you are not safe, reach out now. These people are there to listen.
help.emergency: If you are in immediate danger, call {number}.
help.emergencyUnknown: If you are in immediate danger, call your local emergency number.
help.directory: Find a helpline in your country
help.directoryNote: {note} This link needs an internet connection.
footer.selfHelp: Freelief is a self-help tool. It is not medical care.
